text: 隐藏着一个我们从未完全探索过的世界。
native: lies a world we have never fully explored.

text: 这里的生物进化出了独特的生存机制，
native: Creatures here have evolved unique survival mechanisms,

text: 能够在极高的压力和完全黑暗的环境中繁衍生息。
native: capable of thriving under extreme pressure and in complete darkness.

text: 每个微小的生命都在这片寂静的深渊里，
native: Every tiny life in this silent abyss,

text: 书写着关于生存与进化的史诗。
native: is writing an epic of survival and evolution.
